description: §14.8.9 S441 round 5 (F1) — `.length` is a DERIVED count only on a value whose length is a count of independent identity (the column's own string, a string built from it, an array literal, a mapped / filtered array, a row array). `new Array(u.pin).length` IS the pin, so it is E-PROTECT-006 at egress.
rationale: MEASURED before the fix (S441 round-4 review, F1): `.length` was treated as derived on ANY receiver, so `({ length: h }).length` and `new Array(u.pin).length` served the protected value with HTTP 200.
